document, issuing bodies and date: Plan for computing infrastructure, 2024 to 2025, known as the Yue Suan plan (number 粤通联〔2024〕3号). share in the page's own words: 到2030年，浙江信息通信行业算力规模达150EFLOPS，国产化算力占比超60%
other words of the page: It stands as the target of a key project, under the heading "重点工程4:算力网络一体化提升工程". The plan's table of indicators has the line "智能算力规模(EFLOPS) 150 450 预期性" and no line for home-made computing. The province's AI measures of 2025, the document first read for this row, say: "倡导政府部门、算力中心、经营主体采购或应用国产软硬件"
our English and limits: (by 2030 the computing of Zhejiang's information and communications industry reaches 150 EFLOPS, with home-made computing over 60% of it; key project 4, raising the computing network as one; intelligent computing, in EFLOPS, 150 in 2025 and 450 in 2030, indicative; advocate that government departments, computing centres and businesses buy or use home-made software and hardware). The project's 150 EFLOPS is the computing of the information and communications industry; the indicator's 450 EFLOPS is intelligent computing; the page does not say how the two relate. The share is for the computing of one sector, by 2030, and it is a project's target: it is not one of the plan's eighteen indicators, seventeen of them marked indicative and one, the power use of new large data centres, binding. Its sentence does not open with 力争 (strive), and the page does not say how home-made is judged. The AI measures are an appeal with voucher rates and set no share. A computing plan proper of the provincial government was not found. A search of the communications administration's site for a computing-infrastructure plan, on Nov 23, 2026, did not return this sector plan; a search of Nov 25, 2026 found it. The like plans of the other fifteen governments' communications administrations were searched as a class the same day (the section on searches). A 2025 opinion on the intelligent-computing cloud is still a lead only: a search summary says it pushes newly added computing toward home-made hardware steadily, with no number, and four addresses of accounts of it did not open. The province's own pages of the AI measures did not open when tried on Nov 23, 2026; the provincial government's own signed PDF of the measures is held [cn-ga31-plantexts-1].
